```{r}
gibbs_sampler <- function(data, samples_count, m_0, s2_0, a, b, alpha_0, beta_0, burn) {
  n <- length(data)
  parameters <- list(
    zs = matrix(numeric(n*samples_count), ncol = n, nrow = samples_count),
    mu_1 = numeric(samples_count),
    mu_2 = numeric(samples_count),
    pi = numeric(samples_count),
    sigma2 = numeric(samples_count)
  )
  #Initialise prior values from distribution
  parameters$mu_1[1] <- rnorm(1, m_0, s2_0)
  parameters$mu_2[1] <- rnorm(1, m_0, s2_0)
  parameters$pi[1] <- rbeta(1, a, b)
  parameters$sigma2[1] <- 1/rgamma(1, alpha_0, beta_0)
  parameters$zs[1,] <- rbinom(n, 1, 1-parameters$pi[1]) + 1
  for (t in 2:samples_count) {
    mu_1 <- parameters$mu_1[t-1]
    mu_2 <- parameters$mu_2[t-1]
    pi <- parameters$pi[t-1]
    sigma2 <- parameters$sigma2[t-1]
    zs <- parameters$zs[t-1,]
    z_i <- numeric(n)
    for (i in 1:n) {
      y_i <- data[i]
      p_1 <- dnorm(y_i, mu_1, sigma2)*pi/
        (pi*dnorm(y_i, mu_1, sigma2)+(1-pi)*dnorm(y_i, mu_2, sigma2))
      if (runif(1, 0, 1) < p_1) {
        z_i[i] <- 1
      } else {
        z_i[i] <- 2
      }
    }
    zs <- z_i
    parameters$zs[t,] <- zs
    
    N_1 <- sum(sapply(zs, function(x) x == 1))
    pi <- rbeta(1, a + N_1, b + n - N_1)
    parameters$pi[t] <- pi
    
    y_bar_1 <- sum(data[which(sapply(zs, function(x) x == 1))])
    mu_1 <- rnorm(1, 
                  (m_0 + y_bar_1)/(sigma2 + s2_0*N_1),
                  (s2_0*sigma2)/(sigma2+s2_0*N_1)
    )
    parameters$mu_1[t] <- mu_1
    N_2 <- sum(sapply(zs, function(x) x == 2))
    y_bar_2 <- sum(data[which(sapply(zs, function(x) x == 2))])
    mu_2 <- rnorm(1, 
                  (m_0 + y_bar_2)/(sigma2 + s2_0*N_2),
                  (s2_0*sigma2)/(sigma2+s2_0*N_2)
    )
    parameters$mu_2[t] <- mu_2
    if (is.na(mu_1) || is.na(mu_2)) {
    browser()
    }

    alpha_k = alpha_0 + n/2
    beta_k_1 = beta_0 + 1/2 * sum((data-mu_1)^2)
    beta_k_2 = beta_0 + 1/2 * sum((data-mu_2)^2)
    sigma2 = pi * 1/rgamma(1, alpha_k, beta_k_1) + (1-pi) * 1/rgamma(1, alpha_k, beta_k_2)
    parameters$sigma2[t] <- sigma2
   
  }
  parameters
}
```
